---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new feature for this project
title: "[FEATURE] Brief description"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Overview
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you're proposing.

## Background / Context
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve? Provide any relevant background information.

## Objectives / Success Criteria
What specific outcomes would indicate that this feature is successfully implemented?

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If you have specific implementation ideas, include them here.

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope & Approach
**In scope:**
- What should be included in this feature

**Out of scope:**
- What should be excluded from this feature

## Dependencies & Risks
List any dependencies this feature has on other systems or features, and any potential risks in implementation.
